    • setSubscriber

      public void setSubscriber(Consumer<OOCStream.QueueCallback<IndexedMatrixValue>> subscriber)
      Description copied from interface: OOCStream
      Registers a new subscriber that consumes the stream. While there is no guarantee for any specific order, the closing item LocalTaskQueue.NO_MORE_TASKS is guaranteed to be invoked after every other item has finished processing. Thus, the NO_MORE_TASKS callback can be used to free dependent resources and close output streams.
      Specified by:
      setSubscriber in interface OOCStream<IndexedMatrixValue>
